intent: Adaptive follow-up on three difficult TRAIN originals after the first visual replay. Same requests; test intermediate strength and two plausible bright-area or colour constraints. Do not infer impossible edits beyond the tested range.

instructions.zh: 把霓虹灯旁的人像提亮到能清楚看见五官，保留霓虹灯颜色，暗处不要出现显眼色斑。
instructions.en: Brighten the portrait next to the neon sign until the facial features are clear, while keeping the neon colours and avoiding obvious blotches in the shadows.

instructions.zh: 提亮树林夜景的暗部，让中下部的树干和地面可以清楚辨认，避免明显色斑。
instructions.en: Lift the shadows of this woodland night scene so the trunks and ground in the lower half are clearly recognizable, without obvious colour blotches.

instructions.zh: 提亮火光附近的夜景暗部，清楚显示周围地形，保留火光颜色且不出现明显色块。
instructions.en: Lift the shadows near the fire until the surrounding terrain is clearly visible, while keeping the fire colour and avoiding obvious blotches.
